<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 268.194, the ion is most likely the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.19 Da. The formula that best matches this mass with only C, H, O atoms is C₁₅H₂₃O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H23O4</final_answer>
